rationale: P characterises the braking behaviour whose omission T requires preventing. SG-1 and FR-7 establish that this system response is itself the subject of evaluation, not merely a mechanism affecting another phenomenon. The obstacle-encounter scope and inclusion of braking initiation are supported by the supplied artefacts. P does not expand into sensing, computation, communication, or unrelated control behaviour.
determining_elements: “Vehicle/system braking behavior” directly corresponds to preventing omitted braking under SG-1 and performing collision-avoidance braking under FR-7.
“Whether a braking maneuver is initiated when required” is supported by FR-7 and FR-7.1, which explicitly require braking and specify its initiation after dangerous-zone obstacle detection.
The scope covering obstacles or road users on or near the trajectory is supported by H-1, FR-7, and FR-7.2.4, and remains conditional on potential collision-avoidance braking need.
The reference to obstacle-detection situations supplies encounter context; it does not incorporate detection mechanisms or their processing-time requirements into P.
